verses.en: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.pt: E levantando-se toda a multidão deles, o levaram a Pilatos.
verses.en_web: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
verses.en_bbe: And they all went and took him before Pilate.

verses.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.pt: E começaram a acusá-lo, dizendo: Encontramos este homem,que perverte a nação, e proíbe dar tributo a César, dizendo que ele mesmo é Cristo, o Rei.
verses.en_web: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
verses.en_bbe: And they made statements against him, saying, This man has to our knowledge been teaching our nation to do wrong, and not to make payment of taxes to Caesar, even saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

verses.en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
verses.pt: E Pilatos lhe perguntou, dizendo: Tu és o Rei dos judeus?E respondendo, ele lhe disse: Tu o dizes.
verses.en_web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate said to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he said in answer, You say so.

verses.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.pt: E Pilatos disse aos chefes dos sacerdotes, e às multidões: Não acho culpa nenhuma neste homem.
verses.en_web: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the people, In my opinion this man has done no wrong.

verses.en: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.pt: Mas eles insistiam, dizendo: Ele incita ao povo, ensinando por toda a Judeia, começando desde a Galileia até aqui.
verses.en_web: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
verses.en_bbe: But they became more violent than before, saying, He has made trouble among the people, teaching through all Judaea from Galilee to this place.

verses.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.pt: Então Pilatos, ouvindo falar da Galileia, perguntou se aquele homem era galileu.
verses.en_web: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
verses.en_bbe: But at these words Pilate said, Is the man a Galilaean?

verses.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.pt: E quando soube que era da jurisdição de Herodes, ele o entregou a Herodes, que naqueles dias também estava em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
verses.en_bbe: And when he saw that he was under the authority of Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem himself at that time.

verses.en: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.pt: E Herodes, ao ver Jesus, alegrou-se muito, porque havia muito tempo que desejava o ver, pois ouvia muitas coisas sobre ele; e esperava ver algum sinal feito por ele.
verses.en_web: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Herod saw Jesus he was very glad, having for a long time had a desire to see him, for he had had accounts of him, and was hoping to see some wonders done by him.

verses.en: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.pt: E perguntava-lhe com muitas palavras, mas ele nada lhe respondia;
verses.en_web: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
verses.en_bbe: And he put a great number of questions to him, but he said nothing.

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.pt: E estavam lá os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, acusando-o com veemência.
verses.en_web: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
verses.en_bbe: And the chief priests and the scribes were there, making statements against him violently.

verses.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.pt: E Herodes, com seus soldados, desprezando-o, e escarnecendo dele, o vestiu com uma roupa luxuosa, e o enviou de volta a Pilatos.
verses.en_web: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
verses.en_bbe: And Herod, with the men of his army, put shame on him and made sport of him, and dressing him in shining robes, he sent him back to Pilate.

verses.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.pt: E no mesmo dia Pilatos e Herodes se fizeram amigos; porque antes tinham inimizade um contra o outro.
verses.en_web: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
verses.en_bbe: And that day Herod and Pilate became friends with one another, for before they had been against one another.

verses.en: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.pt: E Pilatos, convocando aos chefes dos sacerdotes, aos líderes, e ao povo, disse-lhes:
verses.en_web: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate sent for the chief priests and the rulers and the people, and said to them,

verses.en: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.pt: Vós me trouxestes a este homem, como que perverte o povo; e eis que eu, examinando-o em vossa presença, nenhuma culpa eu acho neste homem, das de que o acusais.
verses.en_web: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
verses.en_bbe: You say that this man has been teaching the people evil things: now I, after going into the question before you, see nothing wrong in this man in connection with the things which you have said against him:

verses.en: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.pt: E nem também Herodes; porque a ele eu vos remeti; e eis que ele nada fez para que seja digno de morte.
verses.en_web: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
verses.en_bbe: And Herod is of the same opinion, for he has sent him back to us; for, you see, he has done nothing for which I might put him to death.

verses.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
verses.pt: Então eu o castigarei, e depois o soltarei.
verses.en_web: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
verses.en_bbe: And so I will give him punishment and let him go.

verses.en: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.pt: E ele tinha de soltar-lhes alguém durante a festa.
verses.en_web: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

verses.en: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.pt: Porém todos clamavam juntos, dizendo: Tirai-o daqui! E soltai Barrabás para nós!
verses.en_web: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
verses.en_bbe: But with loud voices they said all together, Put this man to death, and make Barabbas free.

verses.en: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.pt: (O qual por uma rebelião feita na cidade, e por uma morte, tinha sido lançado na prisão).
verses.en_web: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
verses.en_bbe: Now this man was in prison because of an attack against the government in the town, in which there had been loss of life.

verses.en: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.pt: Pilatos falou-lhes então outra vez, querendo soltar Jesus.
verses.en_web: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate again said to them that it was his desire to let Jesus go free.

verses.en: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
verses.pt: Mas eles clamavam, dizendo: Crucifica -o! crucifica-o!
verses.en_web: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
verses.en_bbe: But crying out they said, To the cross with him!

verses.en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse a terceira vez: Pois que mal este fez? Nenhuma culpa de morte nele eu achei. Então eu o castigarei, e depois o soltarei.
verses.en_web: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them a third time, Why, what evil has he done? I see no reason for putting him to death: I will give him punishment and let him go.

verses.en: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.pt: Mas eles continuavam, com grandes gritos, pedindo que fosse crucificado. E seus gritos, e os dos chefes dos sacerdotes, prevaleceram.
verses.en_web: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.en_bbe: But they went on crying out loudly, Let him be put to death on the cross. And they had their way.

verses.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.pt: Então Pilatos julgou que se fizesse o que pediam.
verses.en_web: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
verses.en_bbe: And Pilate gave his decision for their desire to be put into effect.

verses.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.pt: E soltou-lhes ao que fora lançado na prisão por uma rebelião e uma morte, que era o que pediam; porém a Jesus lhes entregou à sua vontade.
verses.en_web: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
verses.en_bbe: And in answer to their request, he let that man go free who had been in prison for acting against the government and causing death, and Jesus he gave up to their pleasure.

verses.en: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
verses.pt: E enquanto o levavam, tomaram a um Simão Cireneu, que vinha do campo, e puseram-lhe a cruz às costas, para que a levasse atrás de Jesus.
verses.en_web: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And while they were taking him away, they put their hands on Simon of Cyrene, who was coming from the country, and made him take the cross after Jesus.

verses.en: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.pt: E seguia-o uma grande multidão do povo, e de mulheres, as quais também ficavam desconsoladas, e lamentavam por ele.
verses.en_web: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
verses.en_bbe: And a great band of people went after him, and of women making signs of grief and weeping for him.

verses.en: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.pt: E Jesus, virando-se para elas, disse: Filhas de Jerusalém, não choreis por mim, mas chorai por vós mesmas, e por vossos filhos.
verses.en_web: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus, turning to them, said, Daughters of Jerusalem, let not your weeping be for me, but for yourselves and for your children.

verses.en: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.pt: Porque eis que vêm dias em que dirão: Bem-aventuradas as estéreis, e os ventres que não deram a luz, e os peitos que não amamentaram.
verses.en_web: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
verses.en_bbe: For the days are coming in which they will say, Happy are those who have had no children, whose bodies have never given birth, whose breasts have never given milk.

verses.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.pt: Então começarão a dizer aos montes: Cai sobre nós; E aos morros: Cobri-nos!
verses.en_web: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
verses.en_bbe: And they will say to the mountains, Come down on us, and to the hills, Be a cover over us.

verses.en: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.pt: Porque, se fazem isto à árvore verde, o que se fará com a árvore seca?
verses.en_web: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
verses.en_bbe: For if they do these things when the tree is green, what will they do when it is dry?

verses.en: And there were also two others, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.pt: E também levaram outros dois, que eram malfeitores, para matar com ele.
verses.en_web: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And two others, evil-doers, were taken with him to be put to death.

verses.en: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.pt: E quando chegaram ao lugar, chamado a Caveira, o crucificaram ali, e aos malfeitores, um à direita, e outro à esquerda.
verses.en_web: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to the place which is named Golgotha, they put him on the cross, and the evil-doers, one on the right side, and the other on the left.

verses.en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.pt: E Jesus dizia: Pai, perdoa-lhes, porque não sabem o que fazem. E, repartindo suas roupas, lançaram sortes.
verses.en_web: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said, Father, let them have forgiveness, for they have no knowledge of what they are doing. And they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.

verses.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.pt: E o povo estava olhando; e os líderes também zombavam com eles, dizendo: Salvou a outros, salve agora a si mesmo, se é o Cristo, o escolhido de Deus.
verses.en_web: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
verses.en_bbe: And the people were looking on. And the rulers made sport of him, saying, He was a saviour of others; let him do something for himself, if he is the Christ, the man of God's selection.

verses.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.pt: E os soldados também escarneciam dele, aproximando-se dele, e mostrando-lhe vinagre;
verses.en_web: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
verses.en_bbe: And the men of the army made sport of him, coming to him and giving him bitter wine,

verses.en: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.pt: E dizendo: Se tu és o Rei dos judeus, salva a ti mesmo.
verses.en_web: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
verses.en_bbe: And saying, If you are the King of the Jews, get yourself free.

verses.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.pt: E também estava acima dele um título escrito com letras gregas, romanas e hebraicas: ESTE É O REI DOS JUDEUS.
verses.en_web: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.en_bbe: And these words were put in writing over him, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.pt: E um dos malfeitores que estavam pendurados o insultava, dizendo: Se tu és o Cristo, salva a ti mesmo, e a nós.
verses.en_web: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
verses.en_bbe: And one of the evil-doers on the cross, with bitter feeling, said to him, Are you not the Christ? Get yourself and us out of this.

verses.en: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.pt: Porém o outro, respondendo, repreendia-o, dizendo: Tu ainda não temes a Deus, mesmo estando na mesma condenação?
verses.en_web: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
verses.en_bbe: But the other, protesting, said, Have you no fear of God? for you have a part in the same punishment,

verses.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.pt: E nós realmente estamos sendo punidos justamente, porque estamos recebendo de volta merecidamente por aquilo que praticamos; mas este nada fez de errado.
verses.en_web: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
verses.en_bbe: And with reason; for we have the right reward of our acts, but this man has done nothing wrong.

verses.en: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.pt: E disse a Jesus: Senhor, lembra-te de mim, quando chegares em teu Reino.
verses.en_web: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Jesus, keep me in mind when you come in your kingdom.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Em verdade te digo, hoje estarás comigo no paraíso.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Truly I say to you, Today you will be with me in Paradise.

verses.en: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.pt: E era já quase a hora sexta, e houve trevas em toda a terra, até a hora nona.
verses.en_web: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.en_bbe: And it was now about the sixth hour; and all the land was dark till the ninth hour;

verses.en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.pt: E o sol se escureceu, e o véu do templo se rasgou ao meio.
verses.en_web: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
verses.en_bbe: The light of the sun went out, and the curtain in the Temple was parted in two.

verses.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.pt: E Jesus, clamando em alta voz, disse: Pai, em tuas mãos eu entrego meu espírito.E tendo dito isto, parou de respirar.
verses.en_web: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus gave a loud cry and said, Father, into your hands I give my spirit: and when he had said this, he gave up his spirit.

verses.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.pt: E o centurião, vendo o o que tinha acontecido, deu glória a Deus, dizendo: Verdadeiramente este homem era justo.
verses.en_web: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the captain saw what was done, he gave praise to God, saying, Without doubt this was an upright man.

verses.en: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.pt: E todas as multidões que se juntavam para observar, vendo o que tinha acontecido, voltaram, batendo nos peitos.
verses.en_web: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people who had come together to see it, when they saw the things which were done, went back again making signs of grief.

verses.en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.pt: E todos os seus conhecidos, e as mulheres que acompanhando -o desde a Galileia, tinham o seguido, estavam longe, vendo estas coisas.
verses.en_web: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
verses.en_bbe: And all his friends and the women who came with him from Galilee, were waiting at a distance, watching these things.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
verses.pt: E eis que um homem, de nome José, membro do conselho de justiça,sendo homem bom e justo.
verses.en_web: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a man named Joseph, a man of authority and a good and upright man

verses.en: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: (Que não tinha concordado, nem com o conselho, nem em atos que fizeram), da cidade de Arimateia, da terra dos judeus, e que também esperava pelo Reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom:
verses.en_bbe: (He had not given his approval to their decision or their acts), of Arimathaea, a town of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God:

verses.en: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.pt: Este, chegando a Pilatos, pediu o corpo de Jesus.
verses.en_web: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
verses.en_bbe: This man went to Pilate and made a request for the body of Jesus.

verses.en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.pt: E tendo o tirado, o envolveu em um tecido de linho, e o pôs em um sepulcro, escavado em uma rocha, onde nunca ainda tinha sido posto.
verses.en_web: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
verses.en_bbe: And he took it down, and folding it in a linen cloth, he put it in a place cut in the rock for a dead body; and no one had ever been put in it.

verses.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.pt: E era o dia da preparação, e o sábado estava começando.
verses.en_web: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
verses.en_bbe: Now it was the day of making ready and the Sabbath was coming on.

verses.en: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
verses.pt: E as mulheres que vieram com ele da Galileia também o seguiram, e viram o sepulcro, e como seu corpo foi posto.
verses.en_web: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.
verses.en_bbe: And the women who had come with him from Galilee went after him and saw the place and how his body had been put to rest;

verses.en: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
verses.pt: E elas, ao voltarem, prepararam materiais aromáticos e óleos perfumados. E descansaram o sábado, conforme o mandamento.
verses.en_web: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
verses.en_bbe: And they went back and got ready spices and perfumes; and on the Sabbath they took their rest, in agreement with the law.
